en.topic_title: Barrister group asks court to overturn decision clearing democrat Margaret Ng of misconduct linked to 2019 protest conviction
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s professional body for barristers has asked a court to overturn its own disciplinary board’s decision clearing pro-democracy figure Margaret Ng of misconduct linked to her 2019 protest conviction.



Margaret Ng leaves Hong Kong’s High Court surrounded by reporters on August 14, 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



The Hong Kong Bar Association (HKBA) applied for a judicial review of the board’s decision at the High Court on Friday, local media reported.
